title: エリザベス女王杯の後に・姫の戦いは

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Guess who dominated the Queen Elizabeth II Cup. Me! OH YEAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But it doesn't really change how everyone sees me. Some people still won't accept me as a princess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's exactly why I'm going to keep running! I'm going to be the princess I'm proud of and charge into the future with a Princess☆Punch!
